question.text: The isoelectric-point of a colloidially dispersed material is the $\mathrm{pH}$ value at which

options.text: the dispersed phase migrate in an electric field.
the dispersed phase does not migrate in an electric field.
the dispersed phase has $\mathrm{pH}$ equal to 7 .
the dispersed phase has pH equal to zero.

solution.text: At isoelectric point there is no migration of dispersed phase in an electric field.
